system.longDesc:
This represents a number of shoulder-fired missile launchers. The most sophisticated versions fire guided missiles. These provide a +1 to +3 bonus to attack rolls when the operator uses the Aim action before firing. This is in addition to the bonus granted by Aim itself. Examples: AT4, RPG-7 and successors. Note that the range is in the middle ground for these weapons. Newer weapons will have a longer range.

Focus: Longarms. Minimum Strength 3. Range 200 yards. Reload: 1d6 Minor. Resources TN 15.
